title: The composer row Create and Import carry the conversation draft to Add site
steps: Mount the onboarding composer with a settled request, press the row Create button.
Press the row buttons with no settled request, with Templates, and with a failing draft.
expect: One POST /api/assistant/onboarding-draft with the request revision; the start event carries chatDraft and its platform.
The plain start otherwise, one press at a time.

tests: the row’s Create carries the conversation’s prepared draft to Add site
the composer row’s Create and Import carry the chat’s draft
